# Triple R Holidays

Triple R Holidays is a travel agency based in Wattala, Sri Lanka. The company plans Sri Lanka inbound tours, outbound holiday packages, hotel bookings, destination weddings, corporate travel support and transport services.

## Official Site

- Homepage: https://triplerholidays.com/
- Sri Lanka tour packages: https://triplerholidays.com/holiday-tours/
- Outbound holiday packages: https://triplerholidays.com/outbound-tours/
- Travel services: https://triplerholidays.com/services/
- Corporate partnerships: https://triplerholidays.com/cooperate/
- About and contact: https://triplerholidays.com/about/

## Key Services

- Inbound tours across Sri Lanka, including cultural routes, Ramayana heritage journeys, highlands, wildlife and coastal itineraries.
- Outbound holiday packages from Sri Lanka to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Maldives and other destinations.
- Hotel booking support, destination wedding coordination, transport services, conferences and group travel logistics.
